mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (industrial production) signals expanding supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GDPC1 (GDP growth) reflects stronger consumer and business demand, which lowers discount rates and elevates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% triggers a monetary easing cycle, reducing long-term interest rates and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS falls below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (GDP growth) creates a dual signal of monetary easing and robust demand, amplifying equity valuation growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS falls and GDPC1 rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 3.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which raises long-term interest rates and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 5.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (GDP growth) and INDPRO (industrial production) signals robust demand-side and supply-side expansion, which synergistically boosts corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime, a sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% signals strengthening labor demand, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when UNRATE falls below 4.5% in labor market recovery.
